body: Hey @fubezz, I read your detailed post about the 21,144 sats lost during token creation. That sounds like a particularly frustrating situation, especially with the balance still showing funds you can't actually spend. Has there been any progress on recovering them, or is the situation still unresolved?
@callebtc happy to adjust anything here if it helps for the release.
Closing: upstream formatCurrency now has the same try/catch fallback, so this is covered.
